title: Today Show Canoe
summary: An NBC Today Show correspondent appears to row a canoe in deep storm floodwater, though the water is only about six inches deep. The uploader notes it is a misleading depiction rather than intentional fake news.
why: HN commenters use it as a favorite example of how TV imagery can craft a misleading reality.

quote.text: this is my favorite example of imagery's ability to craft a reality
